name: Frontend polish
description: Polish one visible frontend journey with measured layout, interaction, responsive, and accessibility evidence.

outcomes.description: The targeted journey has a clearer visual hierarchy and responsive layout at agreed viewports.
The journey still behaves correctly for keyboard, pointer, loading, and failure states.

prerequisites.description: The screen, user action, supported viewports, and visual success signal are named.
prerequisites.check: Write a short before-state description and the important states to inspect.

prerequisites.description: A safe local or preview environment is available for visual and behavior checks.
prerequisites.check: Confirm no credentials, private content, or live mutation is needed.

lanes.objective: Define the target journey, states, viewports, and visual acceptance evidence.
Apply the focused visual and interaction improvements without unrelated screen changes.
Inspect visual, responsive, keyboard, and console outcomes against the brief.

qualityGates.description: The intended visual difference is visible at each agreed viewport without clipping.
Interaction, loading, failure, and keyboard checks show no regression on the journey.
Only the named journey and its owned files changed, with a redacted receipt ready.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response while viewing the journey.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; inspect only a safe logged-in session already available.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Change billing, account security, destructive data, or live financial behavior from the polished screen.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Visual work must stay in a preview or safe test path.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Keep the before-state capture and return to the last known-good visual integration point if behavior or layout regresses.
rescueSteps: Save redacted captures and console summaries.
Preserve the scoped style or component patch.
Record which viewport or state remains unresolved.
stopConditions: The target journey cannot be reproduced safely.
A visual change requires unrelated product behavior.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit credentials, tokens, private paths, and private page content.
Use redacted captures and safe route names only.
